item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena reads that natural forces like wind, rain and flowing water slowly act on rocks and soil near her village in Uttarakhand. Her teacher says a change is physical when no new substance is formed, and chemical when a new substance forms.

Which slow natural change is a physical change?

options.A: rain water dissolving minerals in rock to form a new substance
options.B: wind breaking a rock into smaller pieces of the same rock
options.C: iron in the soil rusting after years of contact with moist air
options.D: plant acids slowly reacting with the surface of a stone
